items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post. Letter states: 'Bei Versand mit der Post ist der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.' Counting 4 days from 20.11.2026: 21.11 (Sat, day1), 22.11 (Sun, day2), 23.11 (Mon, day3), 24.11 (Tue, day4) -> deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on 24.11.2026, a regular working day in NW (no weekend/holiday adjustment needed). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (24.11.2026) is not counted; the one-month period starts 25.11.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends with the expiry of the day of the last month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. the 24th of the following month -> 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in NRW (only 25./26.12 are holidays), so no further shift applies. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
